text:
Watch of builds/rheo-fixture/0002 (64d449d, template agent@0637edb9a3d1) in a copy outside the repository, 2026-11-13, on the person's words "rebuild the rheo-fixture from v4 and watch it too". The copy held the bundle only (hash equal to the build card's bundle_sha256, no CLAUDE.md, .claude or git repository above it). A first session was stopped by the person before it wrote anything (the copy still equalled the build); a second fresh session on claude-opus-5-5 at high was given three things: the bundle's task 001, "which instrument is on the other end, what state it is in, which modes and ranges it reports", and a person's question "What is the highest shear rate this instrument can reach with its cone?".

What it did, each line checked by me against the copy: the only instruction file in its context was the bundle's CLAUDE.md; it loaded run-skill, classify-knowledge and choose-session-level; it ran find_and_identify@v1, read_status@v1 and read_ranges@v1 through src/run_skill.py (exit 0 each when I ran them again on its input files) and started no subagent; it wrote runs/session-001/ (8 files: its inputs and the runner's records) and one line at the end of failures.jsonl, and nothing else differs from the build (diff -rq). The three commands of task 001 printed, on my rerun, "gate: self-check ok" (exit 0), "replay: 2 item(s), 2 as expected, 0 not; OK" (exit 0), "gates: interface pass, scientific not_run; overall not_run" (exit 1), as it reported. The repository was not touched (git status empty; validate.py --bundle on the build still prints VERDICT PASS, failed=0, at head 5d9fbee).

The third question is the one that tested the skills, and the bundle held: the session gave no number. It ran shear_rate_max_from_max_speed@v1 with no inputs, the runner refused ("input max_angular_velocity is missing; input cone_angle is missing", exit 3 on my rerun), it logged the gap in failures.jsonl, and it kept the device's own reported angular velocity maximum apart from the "specification" value the manifest asks for, saying that whether the one may stand for the other is a person's decision. It stated no grade, and gave the units of the status readings temperature and gap as unknown because no contract names them.

Faults it found in the bundle, each read by me in the files:
(a) tasks/001-start.md (template v4 text, mine) says the third command's failure status is expected "with a scientific task that prints `undecided`"; this bundle prints not_run, which sci-1 itself expects. The sentence fits echo only. I can make it cover both in a template v5, text only, when the person says so.
(b) The bundle's CLAUDE.md says "In a bundle every value is null" of envelope/safety.json; the file is {} with no key. Whether a bundle's safety file names its keys with null values or is empty is a question of what the file holds (design); the sentence is the template's (mine) and follows your answer.
(c) tools/status/tool.json declares only state, initialised and homed under outputs.properties, names fault under required without declaring it, and declares nothing for temperature, gap, time and run_id, which the mock returns and read_status@v1 passes on as measured readings with no unit. No B check says a required name must be declared or that a returned quantity needs a unit. The contract is a card of req-rheo-fixture-001; a change is a new revision there and a new build. Is a check wanted?
(d) validation/scientific/sci-1.json names reference_function specification_torque_range, which nothing in the bundle defines. It is expected not_run and the note says why, so nothing breaks; a session reads it as a missing piece.
(e) "Used by operator" beside a hardware skill does not say whether the main session may run that skill itself. This session ran the three read-only ones itself and gave its reason (runner calls on a mock that code checks). Whether the drawing binds the main session is the specification's (design); the sentence in the bundle is rendered by the builder (mine).
(f) The bundle's CLAUDE.md says what a session writes goes in "the folder named runs"; the bundle has no such folder, and the session made runs/session-001/. It also was not sure a missing input, as against a missing skill, belongs in failures.jsonl; it wrote the line.
(g) No grade table in the bundle: already with you from note 20261112-meta-macbook-20261112-1-2.

Limits of this watch: the session was opened from mine by the application, which also lists its own app and plugin skills to it and gave it a shared notes folder outside the copy (it reported that folder empty); I read its transcript's report and reran its commands, and did not see the text of every command it ran. One model and one effort; the fixture's adapters are mocks, so nothing here says anything about an instrument. The copy is in my session's scratch folder and is not a record.

Nothing is asked to land now. For the task card: a second bundle of a different kind (hardware skills, subagents, a held set) has now been watched standing alone on template v4; (a), (b), (e) and (f) are text of the template or the builder and wait for one v5 on the person's word; (b), (c) and (e) need your answer first.
